_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE output of configs/capture_versions.py for a TRL single-GPU run. The versions are what `uv pip compile` resolved for "trl[vllm,peft,math_verify]==1.18.2" "peft>=0.22.0" on Python 3.12 / linux x86_64 on 2026-11-23: the extra caps vllm below 0.34.0, and vllm 0.33.0 pins torch==2.14.0 and transformers>=5.16.1,<5.21.0, so the newest torch 2.15.0 / transformers 5.24.0 cannot be installed alongside it (torch 2.14.x is under advisory GHSA-v32g-mr63-3j83; see the README). The GPU row, the torch_cuda value and the SHA are made up. Packages not installed in this environment are recorded as null, not omitted. For a Tinker run, `params` holds learning_rate / lora_rank / loss_fn / tinker_requirement (and skyrl_server_version when SKYRL_VERSION is exported) and `cookbook_git_sha` the tinker-cookbook checkout.
